title: Explorit Science Center

services.name: summer camps
services.desc: Another summer camp season has come and gone, and we all had a blast! Campers attended our camps between June and August and learned about plants, animals, and space! With the generous donation of air purifiers by First Five Yolo we were able to hold our camps safely in our classroom, with plenty of time spent outdoor activities and walks through Mace Ranch Park. Need for Seeds had our campers learning about all thing’s plants, how they grow, what they need to survive, and about different varieties right in our backyard. Campers dissected seed sprouts, observed pinecones, counted tree rings, made oak gall ink, and planted their own seeds and sprouts to plant at home. Out of this World! took
